name: Lambert's Cafe - Home of Throwed Rolls
description: Established in 1942, Lambert's Cafe is a renowned family-friendly restaurant in Sikeston, Missouri, serving delicious southern fare. Experience our unique tradition of throwing rolls to diners. We offer a full hook-up RV Park at our Sikeston and Ozark locations. Huge selection of cups, apparel, hats and recently added jams, jellies, preserves, beef sticks, and ciders.
